messages:
Emma (release): Starting canary rollout for inference-api v2.3.1 -> prod. Change window 12:30-12:50 PT. Canary will ramp 5% -> 20% over 10m. Watch p50/p95/p99, error rate, and token latency. Release notes: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RELEASE-1234

Deploy Bot: deploy started: inference-api v2.3.1 -> prod, canary 5%, job-id: deploy-1776123456

Cal (infra): Preflight complete. KV cache warmup healthy on canary hosts. Backout runbook: /runbooks/backout-inference-api-v2.3.1.md (follow checklist A->D)

Zoe (oncall): @Emma @Cal ack. I'll watch Grafana dashboard and set a short-lived alert at p95>1200ms for the canary tag.

Deploy Bot: canary reached 5% (t+3m). metrics snapshot: p95=210ms, errors=0.12%

Mike (SRE): Seeing p95 jumping to ~1.8s on canary instances, and a few 500s from model-worker pods. Quick log excerpt: "[2026-03-20T19:34:10Z] WARN model-worker: kv fetch latency spike=1320ms"

Emma (release): Hold canary. @deploy-bot halt canary rollout. If spike doesn't resolve in 2m, initiate backout.

Cal (infra): Backout steps (brief):
```
# pin traffic back to last known-good
redwood traffic pin --service inference-api --version v2.3.0
# or run the runbook helper
/runbooks/backout-inference-api-v2.3.1.md
```

Zoe (oncall): Starting backout runbook now, running checklist items 1-4. Posting progress every update. Re-routing pager to incidents channel.

Deploy Bot: canary halted by user Emma (release). rollback job queued: rollback-1776123456

Mike (SRE): rollback initiated. Reverted model-version on canary instances and drained new pods. Quick check: p95 back to ~230ms on restored traffic.

Emma (release): Backout executed. Pin applied to v2.3.0 and rollout cancelled. Marking this release as blocked pending investigation. :exclamation:

Cal (infra): Routing pin committed: https://github.com/redwood/inference/commit/abcdef123 (branch: rollback/v2.3.1-pin). Ops note added to runbook.

Zoe (oncall): Monitoring stable for 10m after rollback. Closing change window early. Next: schedule postmortem and update canary alerts/thresholds.

Deploy Bot: rollback-1776123456 completed successfully in 2m40s. job-id: rollback-1776123456.

Emma (release): Thanks team. Filing a follow-up ticket for root-cause & guardrails. :thumbsup:
